subject: bgiteration: fix unit-test feed deadlock under slow execution (#4643)
reason: The change is test-infrastructure only. The single C hunk makes bgIteration_feedIterators_task ignore its time budget when called with eventLoop == NULL, and the only NULL-eventLoop callers are the unit-test helper bgIteration_feedIterators() and the main-thread branch of bgIteratorRead, which exists solely for unit tests: the one production consumer of bgIteratorRead (the forkless-save processor in forkless.c) runs on a background thread and asserts !onServerMainThread(), so it never reaches that branch.
